reviews.text: From the first call to them I knew I was going to use them for my cleaning service. They have the best communication. They are quick to set up appointments. They are thorough,they take their time. They explained everything that they find and then you can decide what you want to do.They are very knowledgeable . I have yet to find this kind of service in all my years of owning a pool. You will not regret having this company take care of your pool.
reviews.author: Karie Kahrl

reviews.text: First week in and we're already very satisfied with the result! We just moved in to our first home. The pool hasn't been really taken care of since we moved in because we know nothing about pools, but flower mound pool care came in to the rescue! They're very responsive. Jakson our pool tech was very knowledgeable and thorough. He always make sure we understand everything and answers to every questions we have. I highly recommend flower mound pool care.
reviews.author: Yanie Bermil

reviews.text:
Couldn't be happier with thier services.  I've been through many pool cleaning/maintenance companies and most of them do the bare minimum and techs are mediocre at best.
But clear choice is definitely superior to anyone I have used in the past. Our tech
Carter was very informative and highly professional.  I could tell he takes pride in his work. I highly recommend this company!!
reviews.author: shane skidmore

reviews.text: Pump wouldn't pul but the tech quickly diagnosed and fix the problem.  I had no idea what the problem was but had thing working much quicker than I expected
reviews.author: Robert Gershenfeld

reviews.text: Flower Mound Pool Care has kept my pool looking fabulous for the past 6 years.  They do a fantastic job with the regular maintenance, always taking care of the little things that I really don't want to be bothered with (like the little tail on that pool cleaner), so that we just always have a functioning, sparkling pool to enjoy.  They are also wonderful when it comes to dealing with pump or other issues.  Very reasonably priced and always prompt with service.  We are in the process of selling our house, but if my next house has a pool, they are the only company I would call.  Highly recommend for any pool services!
reviews.author: deana eiland

reviews.text: Clear Choice always does a great job. They communicate well and provide excellent service.
reviews.author: Vanessa Allison

reviews.text: Flower Mound Pool Care has made owning a pool fun and much less stressful. We having been using them for over a year now. They maintain our pool on a weekly basis and we have completed both small and major repair projects with them. The entire team has been great to work with. They are honest, quick to respond, affordable and do a great job. I would highly recommend them to friends and family. In fact, I have!
reviews.author: Kat C

reviews.text: I called to get some information about pool service for my pool and equipment and they gave me some good advice and quotes on the type of service and prices. Katherine is an amazing csr and the way she breaks down the information and answering all the questions

data.summary: Reviews appear highly authentic with strong, consistent praise across all platforms. The single anachronistic date in one review is likely a data scraping error, not an indicator of fake reviews. The company demonstrates excellent service quality and customer satisfaction.
fake_signals: One review references '5 years ago' for a company established in 2023 (possible data error or predecessor business)
authentic_signals: Detailed descriptions of service interactions and problem-solving
Varied writing styles and specific project details
Mentions of long-term customer relationships (e.g., 'past 6 years')
High review counts across multiple platforms are consistent
data.discrepancy_explanation: All platform ratings are consistently high (4.7-4.9) and aligned. BBB A+ rating with no complaints supports positive customer experience.
